en:
Drain Life applies a stack of Nightmare, stacks up to 5. Nightmare increases the periodic healing of your Regrowth by 5%, but increases the cooldown by 2 seconds.

While Nightmare is active your Regrowth applies Growing Nightmare to your allies which causes the initial healing and periodic healing of Regrowth to deal damage to nearby enemies.

Drain Life also applies a stack of Warped Nature, stacks up to 50. Warped Natureincreases your healing power by 1% of your Intellect, but reduces all healing you receive by 2%.

Black Arrow is transformed into Black Arrow (Arctic), dealing Frost damage and granting a stack of Arctic Quiver for 10 seconds on hit. This ability can only be used while the max rank of Sniper Training is active.

Frostbolt critical hit grants a stack of Hail, up to 5 stacks, which causes you next Black Arrow (Arctic) to grant one additional stack of Arctic Quiver per stack of Hail consumed. Arctic Quiver causes your Steady Shot to launch an Ice Lance at your target and apply Fingers of Frost.
